address: 300-302 St Paul's Road, Canonbury, London, N1 2LH, United Kingdom
bio: A stalwart of the local dining scene, this split-level restaurant is a hit with the locals and has a true neighbourhood feel. An open kitchen contributes to the light, buzzy atmosphere and the casually dressed service team are a perfect fit for the style of the place. The daily changing menu of rustic Italian dishes makes great use of the charcoal grill and the delicious pasta is hand-rolled before each service....
